svg.title: orbitFarm: ten crops, forty sprite states
svg.desc: Self-contained Figma import board. Forty unchanged transparent PNG layers are embedded as data URLs. Text and board shapes remain vectors; crop artwork remains raster.
svg.text: A little growth. A lot of possibility.
10 crops · 4 visual states · Transparent PNG artwork
Import this SVG into Figma to place all 40 named image layers at once.
Growth stages are illustrative. Sprite artwork does not encode crop suitability, measurements or growth timing.
Original orbitFarm artwork · Built-in image_gen · Source PNG pixels preserved
